description:
Get Airbnb Listings

Searches Airbnb for available stays by location or map bounding box (neLat/neLng/swLat/swLng) and date range (check-in/check-out) with guest composition (adults, children, infants, pets) and nextPageToken pagination. Returns listing id/url, title, price per night and total, rating, review count, coordinates, and photos. Use for travel planning agents, short-term rental market analysis, pricing/occupancy research, and lead lists for property management.

checkIn.description: The check-in date for the listings.

checkOut.description: The check-out date for the listings.

location.description: The location to search for listings. Required unless a full map bounding box (neLat, neLng, swLat, swLng) is provided.

neLat.description: North-east corner latitude of the map bounding box. When all four bounding-box coordinates are provided, listings are searched within the box instead of by location.

neLng.description: North-east corner longitude of the map bounding box.

nextPageToken.description: The token used to retrieve the next page of results.

swLat.description: South-west corner latitude of the map bounding box.

swLng.description: South-west corner longitude of the map bounding box.
